footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $136M; $134M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures are from the segment note in Palantir's Q2 2024 Form 10-Q. Figures are rounded to whole $M; cost of revenue is shown as $128M (reported $128.6M) and other income as $36M ($47M of interest income less $11M of other expense; reported net $35.4M) so the chart ties exactly to reported totals.
otherDetail: Interest income of $47M on Palantir's cash pile, less $11M of other expense — a net +$36M below operating profit.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for governments, above all the U.S. military and intelligence agencies — U.S. government revenue grew 24% YoY to $278M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 55% to $159M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers.

takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue grew 55% YoY to $159M, the U.S. commercial customer count grew 83% to 295, and U.S. commercial remaining deal value more than doubled, up 103%.
takeaways.title: U.S. business customers surged

takeaways.text: GAAP operating income rose to $105M from $10M a year ago, and net income for shareholders was $134M — a 20% margin — with GAAP EPS of $0.06, up from $0.01 a year ago.
takeaways.title: Profit jumped as revenue outran costs

takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $149M — 22 cents of every revenue dollar — with $4.0B of cash and Treasury securities on hand, and Palantir raised full-year revenue guidance to $2.742–$2.750B.
takeaways.title: Cash piled up, guidance went up

verdict: Palantir's revenue grew 27% to $678M as U.S. commercial sales jumped 55% on AI demand, and it kept $134M as profit for shareholders while raising its full-year outlook.
